question.text:
The EMF of the cell $\mathrm{Tl} / \mathrm{Tl}^{+}(0.001 \mathrm{M}) \| \mathrm{Cu}^{2+}$

$(0.01 \mathrm{M}) / \mathrm{Cu}$ is $0.83 .$ The cell EMF can be increased by

options.text: Increasing the concentration of $\mathrm{Tl}^{+}$ and $\mathrm{Cu}^{2+}$ ions.

solution.text:
The oxidation potential

$\propto \frac{1}{\text { Concentration of ions }}$ and reduction

potential $\propto$ concentration of ions. The cell voltage can be increased by decreasing the concentration of ions around anode or by increasing the concentration of ions around cathode
